rules.v2: emergency rebuild only if cash covers it, else deferred: the segment keeps decaying and keeps the 0.8 capacity cut; no debt from rebuilds
rules.v2e: v2 plus a second growth wave: in a year drawn from 6-9 one or two non-boom areas start growing at a boom rate (seed stream 2), hidden from forecasts until it starts

retrained.experts: tools/experts.py 1000-1199 inside task-v2 (all 200 choose maintenance 2), 194 used (1000-1193)
retrained.bc: cd task-v2 && RL_EXPERT=runs/expert python -m rl.train --name bcv2 --experts 194 --steps 4000 --workers 16
retrained.ppo: cd task-v2 && python -m rl.ppo --init runs/rl/bcv2-c2ba77cb.npz --lr 1e-4 --workers 8 --iters 70 --name ppov2 (training seeds 2008-2567)
retrained.selection: validation 0-15 mean plus worst, every 10 iterations; chosen iteration 60 (480 episodes): mean 0.899, worst 0.458; BC alone mean 0.853, worst 0.285
retrained.eval: RT=<weights> python tools/v2.py measure 0-47 nothing,retrained v2rt (task-v2), 0-15 in task-v2e and in the main tree (v1)
